ui.teamBridge.scope: Full first audit of all 109 keys of the new ur catalogue against en source, context sidecar, glossary and ur style guide; key set, ICU placeholders (parsed with @formatjs), bidi controls, forbidden scripts and NFC verified in the bytes.

findings.note: Same English "More actions for {name}" is rendered as اقدامات in ui.settings.integrations (integration_row.more_actions_for_name); اعمال drifts from it and reads as "deeds".
کل means both yesterday and tomorrow in Urdu, and ui.projects project_model.yesterday already uses گزشتہ روز for the same English term.

Bare ذکر ("remembrance/mention") is cryptic as a notification-level option; the sibling catalogues use ذکر شدہ for mentioned items. Optional, check against the Mute and All messages options in a rendered pass.
English is "Unmute conversation" and menu.mute keeps گفتگو, so the pair is asymmetric and the unmute item drops its object. The menu label gives the context, so this is cosmetic.

findings.note: The subject is dropped, and the string is a tooltip and assistive description that can be read without the row. Add اس نے so it is a complete sentence.
The plural اطلاعات is the usual form for notification settings (compare ui.settings.updates اپ ڈیٹ کی اطلاعات). notify.error carries the same singular.
